newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends flat to higher, in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends flat to higher, in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed unchanged in the benchmark July contract but higher in the back months, in thin and rangebound dealings.

Trading sources said the July/October spread remained under pressure from commission house selling throughout the day. Short-covering by the trade held the spread at 0.14, a recent low, where the spread settled.

The speculators have begun to roll July positions into October ahead of the expiry of the July futures contract on June 30. Liquidation is expected to speed up after July options expire on Friday, dealers said.

Open interest in the front month remains heavy at 78,418 lots, up 715 lots as of early Friday. But market sources said speculators tend to hold contracts until the week before expiy, when activity is likely to accelerate.
Second-position October gained 2,333 lots to 63,353 lots, as of early Friday.
The July contract settled unchanged at 11.45 cents, having ranged from 11.47 to 11.37 cents. October closed up 0.05 to 11.31, and the remaining months finished 0.01 to 0.05 firmer.
Nearby support was pegged at today's low of 11.37 cents, where July formed a double bottom with the low hit on June 6.
An estimated 17,553 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Friday's official 17,414 lots.
